file_name: Fruitico - Terra Farm and Sunsweet Farm - Questionnaire.pdf

questions.text: List the growers of (i) public table grapes and (ii) intellectual property table grapes located in Western Australia, and if known, their annual tonnage.

Can table grapes grown in states other than Western Australia be transported and sold to consumers in Western Australia? Please reference associated additional costs and other barriers interstate table grape growers might encounter when selling their produce in Western Australia.

Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if Fruitico and Terra Farm and Sunsweet Farm are close competitors and there are not many alternatives or if the acquisition will have any impact on the access to table grapes for competing agents and marketers.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Fruitico and/or the Bumbak Group.
